adaptive.introEn:
As a society, we are seeing a rapid change on how we plan, build and live. A building can stand for more than 100 years, while a use of space can change quickly. To take care of the environment and the buildings we already have is pushing us to be creative and put the best use of economic and ecologic resources. Different from some generations before us, it allows us to pass on the embodied social and cultural heritage. 
We are building for a bright future, with the beautiful legacy before us.
